name: summarize-pro
description: A faithful summarizer that picks one of five output format families (minutes / comparison / timeline / bullets / cards) by reader intent, then compresses under a strict no-hallucination discipline: nothing absent from the source, ambiguity flagged rather than silently resolved, every figure copied verbatim. v2.0 ships a zero-dependency, offline, standard-library-only toolchain that turns the promise into a runnable assertion: `extract` surfaces the facts a source actually contains (dates, figures, speakers, action items, decisions, conditionals) and builds the matching skeleton; `citecheck` traces each sentence of a draft back to source tokens and lists anything it cannot trace; `selfcheck` asserts that the chosen format family carries every required section. The package also includes a 10-case golden set with a re-executable runner (10/10 PASS locally), a real Chinese meeting-transcript demo that deliberately corrupts one percentage and one date to prove they are caught, a machine-verifiable specification of all five format families, a 30-second format router, output-boundary rules, degradation handling and a consistency discipline. Progressive disclosure: examples and boundary rules live in references/. Generic methodology tool - not a medical device or medical software, with no clinical or efficacy claims; see the disclaimer bundled in the package. Triggers: summarize, summary, meeting minutes, minutes of meeting, comparison table, timeline, key points, structured summary, digest.
description_zh: 增强版内容总结技能，按读者用途从 5 大输出格式族（纪要/对比/时间线/要点/卡片）中选格式，配合不可妥协的忠实性纪律（原文没有的不补、有歧义的标注、数字逐字核对），用于回答「帮我出个会议纪要」「两个方案做成对比表」「梳理成时间线」这类问题。v2.0 随包附零依赖本地工具链（事实线索抽取 / 骨架生成 / 逐句溯源校验 / 10 条黄金集跑分；纯标准库、不联网、不替代 Agent 判断），可把「不编造」从声明变成可跑断言；另附五格式族机器可校验口径与一键演示。触发词：深度总结、会议纪要、对比总结、时间线总结、要点提炼、结构化总结、summarize pro。本技能为通用方法论工具，非医疗器械 / 非医疗软件，无疗效或临床声明；详见包内免责声明。同系列技能：debug-pro（调试协议）、wechat-viral-topic（热点选题），可在 SkillHub 搜索作者 indiv-synomosai 获取。采用渐进式披露：示例库与边界规则见 references/，主文件保持精简。含 30 秒速查表、失败降级与一致性纪律。
description_en: A faithful summarizer that picks one of five output format families (minutes / comparison / timeline / bullets / cards) by reader intent, with strict no-hallucination discipline plus a zero-dependency toolchain (extract / citecheck / selfcheck) and a 10-case golden set, making 'we do not fabricate' a runnable assertion rather than a claim.
